subject: How to get R shiny output table before program finishes execution

messages.author: 0f280c981477c7b6
messages.subject: How to get R shiny output table before program finishes execution
parts: I created a dashboard with 15 data tables in Shiny. Each table draws data from an API and this process takes some time. So I want to output each table to ui at a time such that users can read the first table while the other ones load. But it seems Shiny always holds all output until server function finishes execution. Is there a way to change this?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to get R shiny output table before program finishes execution
parts:
Sorry, there isn't currently a way to change this, but it's something we're considering for a future release.

One way around this is to limit the number of tables you show in each section/tab. Shiny will hold off on displaying data that isn't currently visible.
